description: Specify the energy tracking state. Currently only mechanical energies can be tracked.

keywords.name: all
keywords.description: Set the energy tracking state of all processes to b .

keywords.name: cfd
keywords.description: Set the energy tracking state of the cfd process to b .

keywords.name: creep
keywords.description: Set the energy tracking state of the creep process to b .

keywords.name: dynamic
keywords.description: Set the energy tracking state of the dynamic process to b .

description.6.0: Set the energy tracking state of the mechanical process to b .
description.7.0: Specify the energy tracking state for the mechanical process.
description.9.0: Specify the energy tracking state for the mechanical process.

keywords.name: thermal
keywords.description: Set the energy tracking state of the thermal process to b .

7.0: The engine also lists creep, dynamic, fluid and thermal. Without that process configured the command hangs the engine and never returns, so configure it first or use all or mechanical.
9.0: The engine also lists creep, dynamic, fluid and thermal. Without that process configured the command hangs the engine and never returns, so configure it first or use all or mechanical.
